blockers.title: admin/admin123 authenticates as the REAL admin account on production (isAdmin=true)
blockers.status: CONFIRMED; tests red for right reasons; §15 step 3 implementation IN FLIGHT
blockers.detail: §1.1 documents admin/admin123 as a NON-admin test user. First-hand probe found it resolves to the same userId as the operator/owner account with isAdmin=true and reaches admin-only endpoints. Contradicts a "GATE-31 verified live" claim in docs/delivery/PROGRESS.md. Every screen test this run has used this credential, so prior UI observations were made as an ADMIN, not as a regular paying user - §3.2 testing must be redone under a genuine non-admin identity.
blockers.blast_radius: Widely-documented demo password grants full production admin, with paying users onboarding imminently.
blockers.next: On CONFIRMED: §15 pipeline - failing test first, then minimal genuine fix, review by a different agent, deploy, prod re-verify.
blockers.corrected_root_cause: AETHER_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH in the production .env is itself a bcrypt hash of the literal string "admin123" - the operator/owner admin password IS admin123. Deleting the seed account or repairing the username=admin demotion/regrant logic would NOT close the hole. Second contributing cause: the identifier "admin" resolves to the owner row. JWT carries NO isAdmin claim; privilege is resolved live from the DB row per request (apps/api/app/middleware/auth.py:48-55), so the token is a plain 24h bearer for the full owner identity.
blockers.confirmed_impact: POST /auth/login {"email":"admin","password":"admin123"} -> 200 as owner; /auth/me -> isAdmin:true; five admin-only endpoints return 200 including GET /admin/users which discloses OTHER USERS' email addresses, plan, subStatus, signup/last-login timestamps and spend. Token TTL 24h.

remediation_split.operator_required_URGENT: Rotate AETHER_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH to a bcrypt hash of a strong unique password. The run CANNOT choose the operator password for them - §18 lists this hash as an operator-held credential.
implementable_now_defence_in_depth: Fail-fast guard rejecting a known-weak AETHER_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH, mirroring _guard_production_replay_mode in apps/api/app/main.py
Stop the literal identifier "admin" resolving to the operator/owner row
Login throttling on POST /auth/login if absent
Re-verify admin-only endpoints return 403 to non-admins and never leak other users' emails
